name: Lanvin
why: The oldest Paris couture house still open, 1889, whose menswear today is the Curb sneaker and a small knit-and-tee range; three US stores, listed as Lanvin Group.
origin: Founded in 1889 in Paris, France (16 Rue Boissy d'Anglas; fashion house on Rue du Faubourg Saint-Honore from 1893) by Jeanne Lanvin.

craft_evidence.owned: no: lanvin.com claims no factory or workshop; the FY2025 20-F describes only a group-level "network of suppliers, manufacturers" with no owned Lanvin production; Copping's appointment text mentions "the atelier" (claim only)
craft_evidence.makers: no: none of 25 men's clothing PDPs (or the 3 loafer/derby PDPs) names a factory, workshop or maker
craft_evidence.mills: no: no cloth or yarn mill named; one jacket says "super150 wool twill" (a grade, not a mill)
craft_evidence.madein: 25 of 25 men's clothing PDPs state the country (Italy 16, Turkiye 5, Portugal 4); shoes Made in Italy; read 11 Oct
craft_evidence.heritage: dated and placed: 1889 hat shop at 16 Rue Boissy d'Anglas, Paris; house on Rue du Faubourg Saint-Honore from 1893; men's made-to-measure "Lanvin Tailor-Shirtmaker" at 15 Rue du Faubourg Saint-Honore, 1926 (history-of-the-house page)
craft_evidence.process: no: PDPs list cut and finish details only; no account of how or where garments are made
craft_evidence.reasoning: Every men's PDP states the country of making (Italy, Turkiye, Portugal) but none names a maker, mill or owned facility, and the brand publishes no process. The dated Paris heritage (1889; menswear tailoring from 1926) is real but is history, not current making; the 20-F shows no owned Lanvin production.

ownership.owner: Lanvin Group Holdings Ltd (NYSE: LANV) via Arpege SAS / Jeanne Lanvin SA (controlling stake acquired 2018; minorities hold 4.73% of Arpege SAS); Lanvin Group controlled by Fosun International (FY2025 20-F)

opview: “Jeanne Lanvin was a visionary of her time whose interests and passions extended far beyond fashion, as do my own.” — Peter Copping, Artistic Director, lanvin.com, History of the House page (appointment announcement)
